title: Oven-Roasted Moroccan Tripe Tangia
description: A resinous, snappy midnight craving dish featuring tender tripe, aromatic temper, and anti-inflammatory spices, baked to a crisp finish.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine tripe, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, turmeric, paprika, cinnamon, olive oil, and water; mix until fully coated.
Transfer the mixture to a shallow baking dish, spreading evenly.
Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake for 60 minutes.
Remove the foil, stir the tripe, and bake uncovered for another 30 minutes until crispy.
While baking, heat a small skillet over medium heat and toast 2 tbsp of cumin seeds and 1 tsp of black pepper until fragrant.
Remove the toasted seeds from heat and add them to the tripe, stirring quickly to distribute the temper.
After baking, let the tripe rest for 5 minutes to set the flavors.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.
Serve hot with a side of steamed couscous or flatbread.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Reheat gently in the oven or microwave until warmed through.
